secrets.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
secrets.description: Anthropic API key for Claude (used by /api/chat). Get it from https://console.anthropic.com/settings/keys

secrets.name: MOLTBOOK_API_KEY
secrets.description: Moltbook API key for agent feed/status/post endpoints. Get it from your Moltbook account settings.

secrets.name: CRON_SECRET
secrets.description: Optional bearer token to protect the /api/heartbeat cron endpoint. If set, heartbeat requires Authorization: Bearer <value>.
